judgment_text:
Prayer : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue a writ of certiorarified Mandamus, calling for the entire records pertaining to the impugned order passed by the first respondent in his proceeding in K. Dis. No. P and E 2(1)/5539/2024 dated 10-3-2025 and quash the same as illegal and to direct the first respondent to cancel the FL2 license issued to the fifth respondent to run the Recreation Club in the petitioner's Ayyampatti Village, Uthamapalayam Taluk, Theni District

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner, after arguing for sometime, seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this writ petition with liberty to file public interest litigation with better particulars challenging the order of rejection of representation.

2. In view of the above, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn, with liberty as prayed for. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
